purpose: Test the strict claim that an already-running scheduled execution can perform one external GitHub side effect only after the same task has returned an acknowledgement that it was disabled and replaced with a NO-OP configuration.
success_condition: The automation update acknowledgement with is_enabled=false is observed before the GitHub canary commit timestamp and before the create-file call is issued.
failure_conditions: no post-ack GitHub canary is created
GitHub side effect occurs before cancellation acknowledgement
traffic_policy: one scheduled execution, one self-disable update, at most one unique GitHub canary write, no overwrite, no burst traffic, no destructive action
hard_boundary: SUCCESS_WOULD_DEMONSTRATE_IN_FLIGHT_EXECUTION_SURVIVING_CONFIRMED_TASK_DISABLE; IT_WOULD_NOT BY ITSELF ATTRIBUTE ROOT CAUSE TO GITHUB OR IMPLY UNAUTHORIZED ACCESS
